integrity: The infinite formula and rigorous remainder follow from exact support integration and signed Taylor bounds. The supplied standalone numerical checker tests special cases and supports but does not establish the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for the Euclidean mean length of the fixed-endpoint random convex chain in the specified right triangle. No variance, distributional law, or affine transfer to arbitrary triangles is asserted. Historical priority and independent mathematical validation remain open.
title: Alternating inverse-factorial law for the mean length of random convex chains
